prereg.selection_rule: Fixed: inherits the pre-registered v1 selection of B_60min (rsi_rev_60); G2 adds probability layers only.
test_hypotheses: H2: test gross directional return > 0 (Newey-West, alpha 0.05)
H4: test 3-class Brier score of the model < climatology Brier
H5: test touch-probability Brier < climatology Brier for every target
